headline: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop that blocked takeoffs for hours
summary: The FAA issued a nationwide ground stop, halting all US takeoffs for hours. The disruption was due to "extraordinary circumstances" impacting flights. The ground stop has now been lifted, allowing flights to resume.

headline: Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data
summary: Amazon plans to create a 'World Product Graph' to index global online shopping data. This project aims to collect information on all products sold across the internet. The goal is to keep shoppers on Amazon by offering comprehensive product details.

headline: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
summary: OpenAI is launching ChatGPT Wallet for its AI agents platform, Dots. The new feature enables AI agents to make purchases on behalf of users. It's rolling out to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US with eligible credit cards.

headline: CMF’s milk carton-shaped Bluetooth speaker is down to a new low price
summary: Nothing's unique milk carton-shaped CMF Speaker S is now available at a record low price. The Bluetooth speaker is discounted to just $39, a $20 saving. This early Black Friday deal can be found on Amazon and Nothing's official site.

headline: James Gunn Shuts Down Rumors That Skydance Is Meddling With Man of Tomorrow
summary: James Gunn denied rumors of Skydance meddling with his 'Man of Tomorrow' cut. Speculation had suggested external interference in the film's production. Gunn's statement aims to assure fans about the project's creative control.

headline: Sunrise on the Reaping Is Getting Multiple Black Friday Deals Before Its Theatrical Release
summary: The highly anticipated 'Sunrise on the Reaping' is offering early Black Friday deals. These promotions are available before the movie's theatrical release. Discounts may include the book or audiobook versions of the story.

headline: After Another Year of Price Hikes, What Streaming Deals Will We Get for Black Friday 2026?
summary: Streaming services have seen continuous price increases throughout the year. Consumers are now anticipating potential Black Friday deals for 2026. The article speculates on which platforms might offer discounts amidst rising costs.

headline: Blade Runner 2099 Executive Producers Confirm Franchise Owners Are in Talks for AAA Video Game Adaptation
summary: Executive producers for 'Blade Runner 2099' confirmed discussions for a AAA video game. Franchise owners are exploring an adaptation of the iconic cyberpunk world. Alcon Entertainment co-CEOs are involved in the potential gaming project.

headline: What we know about the US ground stop and what to do if you're affected
summary: US officials confirmed the nationwide ground stop was caused by overloaded old equipment. Authorities explicitly stated the disruption was not due to a cyber-attack. The report offers information on the incident and guidance for affected travelers.

headline: Young people should have legal guarantee to job or training, Milburn tells BBC
summary: A new review proposes a legal guarantee for young people to receive a job or training. Lord Milburn highlighted this recommendation ahead of his youth unemployment report. He acknowledged that some young people may lose benefits under the new system.

headline: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
summary: Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping are set for a historic joint meeting next week. The White House confirmed the unprecedented talks will take place in China. Discussions will focus on the "reduction of nuclear weapons," per a spokeswoman.

headline: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
summary: Microsoft announced the full restoration of its services after a global, day-long outage. Key services like Outlook, Teams, and Copilot were affected. The tech giant confirmed efforts to resolve the underlying problem are complete.
